body.p: The lake Essey. Many years have passed. At the lake Essey a mammoth was found.[DCh]: Not clear why plural marking; Lake Essey is a single lake. One saws the mammoth's tusks. There was an old woman. The old woman said: "Don't [touch(?)] the mammoth. The mammoth is alive!" The people didn't listen, they(?) are sawing. There the mammoth moved. There the ice [on the] lake cracked. Now it crackles every winter [on] the lake Essey.
